faq.title: A few useful answers.
faq.q1: Can I book just a website or a photo shoot?
faq.a1: Yes. Websites, apps, photography, video, studio space, and equipment rental are available individually. If you need several services, we can plan them together.
faq.q2: Do I need a detailed brief and budget first?
faq.a2: Not yet. Start with what you want to create, examples you like, and your approximate timeline. If you have a budget range, we'll use it to help shape a suitable scope.
faq.q3: Where can I see prices or request a quote?
faq.a3: Explore details and packages on each service page, or choose items from our rental equipment. For a custom project, contact us to discuss the scope and request a quote.

about.metaDescription: Meet Alexan Production — one team for both the camera and the keyboard.
about.title: One team for both the code and the camera
about.subtitle: We keep the digital work and the visual work in one team — product photography, video editing, websites and apps. You brief one team instead of coordinating several.
about.storyParagraph1: Alexan Production started as a photographer shooting products for online shops, and kept running into the same problem: clients got beautiful photos but their website was so slow people left before seeing them, or the site was finished with no decent images to put in it.
about.storyParagraph2: That is not fixed by hiring better vendors. It is fixed by having the people who make the images and the people who write the code on one team from day one. So we built a team that does both, and invested in our own studio and gear rather than renting for every job.
about.value1Body: Ranges are on the site for anyone to see. Nothing new appears on the invoice later.
about.value2Body: Code, master files, usage rights. We do not lock anything to keep you coming back.
about.value3Body: Every project includes a support window, and we still answer questions once it ends.
about.teamTitle: The people you will work with
about.teamSubtitle: A small team doing the work themselves, not passing it along.
about.storyParagraph3: Today clients brief us once and we carry it through — concept, shoot, edit, code, and support after handover. If you already have your own team, you can rent just the equipment or hire us for one part of the work.
about.whatSubtitle: Two sides that usually mean two vendors. We do both and plan them together.
about.whatDigitalBody: Company sites and online stores, web applications with a real admin panel, and mobile apps for iOS and Android. Built for the job at hand, not a recoloured template.
about.whatVisualBody: Product, portrait and interior photography. Video shot and edited for social and advertising. In a light-controlled studio, or on location.
about.whatBothBody: When we build the site we know exactly what sizes and crops the shoot needs. When we shoot we know where each frame will sit. Neither side has to be reworked to fit the other.
about.processSubtitle: The same five steps on every job, so you know what to expect.
about.process1Body: Tell us roughly what you need. It does not have to be fully specified. The first consultation is free.
about.process2Body: We put the scope, timeline and price in writing. Nothing appears on the invoice that was not agreed.
about.process3Body: You see the work at set checkpoints, rather than us disappearing and returning with something finished and unchangeable.
about.process4Body: Source files, source code and usage rights all handed over, plus a walkthrough of the admin panel.
about.process5Body: Every project includes a support period. After it ends you can still ask, or move onto a maintenance agreement.
about.clientsSubtitle: We price by actual scope. There is no minimum designed to filter out smaller budgets.
about.client1Body: Most of our clients — small online sellers, freelancers, and people who want a site of their own.
about.client2Body: Restaurants, hotels, clinics and small manufacturers wanting a site and a fresh set of images.
about.client3Body: Photography, editing or development taken on in parts for agencies that already have their own team.
about.client4Body: Faculty and department websites, institutional videos, and event photography.
about.studioBody: Our studio is in Pak Phanang, Nakhon Si Thammarat — a light-controlled room with continuous lights, studio strobes, backdrops and a product table. Every item is gear our own team uses on client work, and it can be rented separately if you already have a crew.
